title: Demo Builder Demo Packages Schema
description: Schema for defining demo packages with nested storefronts by stack type

packages.description: Array of demo packages (e.g., citisignal, isle5, buildright)

id.description: Unique identifier for the package (lowercase, hyphen-separated)

featured.description: Whether this package should be featured in the UI

addons.description: Addon availability overrides (blacklist model: unlisted addons allowed by default, set 'excluded' to hide)

configDefaults.description: Default configuration values for this package (env var name to value)

storefronts.description: Storefront configurations keyed by stack ID (can be empty for placeholder packages)

name.description: Display name for this storefront variant

description.description: Description of what this storefront includes

featured.description: Whether this storefront should be featured

contentSource.description: DA.live content source for EDS storefronts (required for EDS stacks)

accountContentSource.description: Optional second content source for the customer account chrome (/customer/* auth pages + the /customer/nav fragment). Used by hybrid packages whose brand content comes from one site but whose B2B account experience must come from the canonical B2B content site. Overlaid after the main content copy.

templateOwner.description: GitHub owner of the template repository (for reset-to-template operations)

templateRepo.description: GitHub repository name of the template (for reset-to-template operations)

contentPatches.description: Array of content patch IDs to apply during DA.live content copy

contentPatchSource.description: External repository for content patches (if not using bundled patches)

codePatches.description: Array of code patch IDs to apply during create/reset (canonical files + installed blocks). Sibling of contentPatches; operates on repo files. ADR-006 Step 5.

codePatchSource.description: External repository for code patches. When set, the storefront is thin-layer per ADR-006 — lastSyncedCommit records the LKG SHA and reset pins to LKG.

brandAssets.description: Additive brand files (theme CSS, brand modules) copied from a source repo into the generated storefront repo, plus an optional marker-bounded head.html snippet. ADR-006's prescribed shape for brand CSS.
Additive brand files vendored into generated storefront repos, applied during the shared EDS pipeline (create + reset).

owner.description: GitHub owner/organization of the brand-assets source repository

branch.description: Branch to fetch brand files from (branch HEAD is the contract)

from.description: Source-repo path of the brand file

to.description: Target path in the generated storefront repo. Must be under styles/ with a .css extension or scripts/ with a .js extension — any other target is refused at publish time (non-fatal warn)

files.description: Files to copy verbatim from the source repo into the generated repo

headSnippet.description: Optional HTML snippet vendored into head.html between demo-builder brand-assets markers (idempotent re-vendor on reset). Only <link rel="stylesheet" href="/..."> and <script type="module" src="/..."></script> lines with root-relative paths are accepted; path characters are restricted to A-Za-z0-9 . _ / - (no query strings, spaces, or percent-escapes) — anything else is refused at publish time (non-fatal warn)

codePatchSource.description: External GitHub repository for code patches (thin-layer storefronts per ADR-006). Canonical home: skukla/eds-demo-patches.

owner.description: GitHub owner/organization of the patch repository

path.description: Path within repo to the patch family directory (contains code-patches.json)

lkgFile.description: Optional. Repo-relative path to the LKG file when the ledger tracks a non-default canonical (multi-canonical patches repos). Defaults to root 'last-known-good'. Example: b2b → 'b2b/last-known-good'.

contentPatchSource.description: External GitHub repository for content patches

owner.description: GitHub owner/organization of the patch repository

path.description: Path within repo to patch directory (contains index.json and patch files)

indexPath.description: Path to the content index file (defaults to /full-index.json)

type.description: Source type (currently only git is supported)
